title: (No AI) An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems

author: Jess Weatherbed
content:

title: (No AI) ‘Zoomsday’ hack uncovered using fewer than 20 AI prompts
author: Emma Roth
content:
![An image showing Zoom’s logo on a blue and black background](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/03/acastro_STK059_zoom_03.webp?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Zoom [has patched](https://www.zoom.com/en/trust/security-bulletin/zsb-26015/) a major security vulnerability that could allow an attacker to hijack anyone's device during a meeting. In [a blog post on Tuesday](https://a.security/blog/asecurity-zoomsday), researchers at A Security say they uncovered the flaw using "fewer than 20 prompts on publicly available AI models," [as reported earlier by _Wired_](https://www.wired.com/story/a-zoom-screen-sharing-bug-let-anyone-take-over-other-devices-on-a-call/).

The exploit involved [Zoom's annotation feature](https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0067931), which allows users to draw on their screen while sharing it with other meeting participants. With the exploit, an attacker could join or host a meeting and run malicious code on victims' devices, allowing them to steal data, turn on the camera or microphone, or install malware. The attack required no act …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/977909/zoom-vulnerability-ai-attack)
